title: Special Event Dinners: Seat Price, Seat Limit and Late-Cancellation Fee for Dining Plan Residents
content:
A seat at a Larkspur special event dinner is priced at 34.00 US dollars for residents on every plan of the Dining Plan. The card below gives the seat figures by plan.

| Plan | Special event dinner price (USD per seat) | Seat may be redeemed with one meal credit plus the difference | Most seats per resident per special event | Hours before the event below which a cancelled seat is charged the no-show fee | No-show fee (USD per seat) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dining 10 Meal Plan | 34.00 | No | 2 | 48 | 15.00 |
| Dining 15 Meal Plan | 34.00 | No | 2 | 48 | 15.00 |
| Dining 30 Meal Plan | 34.00 | Yes | 2 | 48 | 15.00 |
| Dining 45 Meal Plan | 34.00 | Yes | 2 | 48 | 15.00 |
| Dining 60 Meal Plan | 34.00 | Yes | 2 | 48 | 15.00 |
| Dining Full Board Plan | 34.00 | Yes | 2 | 48 | 15.00 |

## About the figures

- The seat price, the seat limit of 2 per resident per event, the 48-hour line and the no-show fee of 15.00 US dollars are the same on all six plans.
- The no-show fee is the fee for a special event seat cancelled late or not used.
- The only figure that differs by plan is whether a seat may be taken for one meal credit plus the difference: it may on the Dining 30, 45 and 60 Meal Plans and the Dining Full Board Plan, and it may not on the Dining 10 Meal Plan and the Dining 15 Meal Plan.

*Hypothetical:* a resident on any plan who reserves the full 2 seats for one special event at the seat price is reserving 68.00 US dollars of seats.
